description: Source code for managing RBUS API interactions related to WAN traffic statistics, including initialization, parameter get/set handlers, and validation functions.

methods.name: WTC_RbusInit
methods.description: Initializes RBUS, registers data elements, and adds initial rows to WAN interface table.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Extracts the parameter name from a full path string.

methods.name: IsDigit
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only digits.

methods.name: CheckIfValidDscp
methods.description: Validates if the DSCP string contains only valid DSCP values.

methods.name: Stats_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves string parameters related to WAN traffic stats, with event publishing.

methods.name: Stats_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves ULONG parameters like interval, with event publishing.

methods.name: Stats_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets string parameters such as DSCP enable list, with validation and event publishing.

methods.name: Stats_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets ULONG parameters like interval, with validation and event publishing.
